about: The example's photographs, a set per trade (jtakeit-core wiki/117 §2.3): the same names as PHOTOS in lib/units/photos.mjs, generated with Higgsfield for jtakeit and released with the kit under its licence. The files are not in the package: they are at <media base>media/<site>/<hash16>.jpg (the reserved pseudo-site below), fetched and checked by lib/units/photos.mjs. Placeholders, to be replaced by the business's own.
